headline: Gold Falls 0.75 Percent To $4,044 As Money Leaves The Precious-Metals Pipe
narrative: Gold fell 0.75 percent to $4,044, with money leaving the precious-metals pipe. Silver fell 0.62 percent to $53.96, so both metals in that pipe gave up ground. Copper rose 0.4 percent to $6.65, a smaller industrial bid beside the metals decline.
author: jordan
